interval.visibleText: If it accelerates, the distance depends on how its velocity changes; we need the acceleration or a velocity-versus-time description. If 20 meters per second is the initial velocity and acceleration a is constant, displacement after 30 seconds is 20 × 30 + ½ × a × 30² = 600 + 450a meters, with a measured in meters per second squared. That also equals distance traveled provided the vehicle never reverses direction.
